items.label: Profit Target
items.detail: $50K→$4,000 · $100K→$8,000 · $150K→$12,000. No minimum trading days required.

items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: No daily loss limit during evaluation. Traders manage their own daily risk.

items.label: Max Drawdown
items.detail: $50K→$2,000 · $100K→$3,000 · $150K→$6,000. Trails end-of-day balance. Locks at starting balance + $100 buffer once profit threshold is reached.

items.label: Guardian Shield
items.detail: When combined open floating loss reaches 2% of initial balance, all trades are auto-closed. Soft breach — you may continue trading immediately. In funded: 1st breach→split drops to 50%, 2nd breach→account terminated.

items.label: Consistency — Eval
items.detail: No consistency rule applied during the evaluation phase.

items.label: Consistency — Funded
items.detail: In funded stage, no single day's profit may equal or exceed 30% of total payout-period profits.

items.label: Activation Fee
items.detail: No upfront evaluation cost. $149 activation fee is charged only upon successfully passing the evaluation.

items.label: Evaluation Reset
items.detail: Available within 7 days of failing. Restarts from beginning.

items.label: Trading Hours
items.detail: All open trades auto-close at 16:10 EST. Not a breach.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: No open/close/pending orders within 5 min before or after Red Folder releases. 2-min buffer for all news. Eval: news trading cannot be the sole method to pass.

items.label: Overnight Hold
items.detail: No restriction.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: No restriction.

items.label: Martingale
items.detail: Permitted within margin/contract limits. Inconsistent sizing to recover losses may trigger review.

items.label: Max R:R Ratio
items.detail: Stop loss must not exceed 5× profit target.

items.label: 2% Price Limit
items.detail: No trading within 2% of CME daily price limits.

items.label: Inactivity
items.detail: Funded: at least one trade per 7-day period or account breached.

items.label: Prohibited
items.detail: Microscalping, full AI/bot automation, collaborative trading, account sharing, delayed data exploitation, CME rule violations.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: First $15,000 total profits = 100%. Beyond $15,000 = 90% split.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: Every 14 days. Requires 10 profitable winning days per cycle.

items.label: Winning Day Min.
items.detail: Minimum net profit per winning day by account size.

items.label: Consistency
items.detail: Best single day must not exceed 30% of total payout-period profits.

items.label: Guardian Shield
items.detail: 1st Guardian Shield breach → profit split drops to 50%. 2nd breach → account terminated.

items.label: No Scaling Limit
items.detail: No scaling restrictions in funded. Avoid overleveraging with micro contracts.

items.label: Payout Minimum
items.detail: Minimum payout request.

items.label: First Payout DD
items.detail: After first payout, max drawdown adjusts to starting balance + $100.

items.label: Processing
items.detail: Mon–Fri before 3PM CST via Riseworks. Delay past 24 hrs → $200 bonus.

items.label: Max Funded Accounts
items.detail: Up to 3 funded accounts at any time. Funded accounts cannot be reset.

items.label: Live Account
items.detail: Consistent performers receive live account invitation from risk team.
